en: Color postcard showing a river scene with a hydrofoil boat cruising in the foreground. On the opposite bank stands a classical city embankment with trees and large historic buildings, dominated by a large domed cathedral with a golden cupola. The printed Russian captions below the image read "ЛЕНИНГРАД." on the left and "На Неве." on the right, with handwritten blue ink in the lower-right corner.
